svg.title: 517 genes of human fibroblasts responding to serum, in ten clusters
svg.desc: Schematic of Iyer et al., Science 283:83 (1999), Fig. 2. Left: a heat map of 517 genes in 13 columns (12 times from 0 to 24 hours after serum was added, and an unsynchronized sample), red above the reference and green below, with ten clusters A to J marked by colored bars. The colors are the paper's, averaged over blocks of about five genes. Right: the average profile of each cluster, traced from the paper's small plots and drawn on one common scale of fold change. Clusters A, B and C fall. Cluster E peaks above 6-fold at 1 hour and has mostly fallen back by 2 hours; cluster F peaks later, at about 6 hours. Clusters I and J rise within the first hour and stay up for hours.
svg.text: Fold change from the start: above the dashed line more active, below it less.
